adr: ADR-0005 D3 (locus rule + Stage-2 operating point), D5 (block-level CI), D7 (benchmark decoy prevalence + sweep), A7 (which decoy pools were trained on), A11 Pin 4 (Stage-1 read on the uncalibrated posterior), A12 (the P2 checkpoint is canonical); ADR-0004 A6 (eval twin / two-run split); ADR-0005 A13 (the statistic, unchanged), A15 Pins 1–2 (the screens, unchanged), A16 Pin 5 (reported beside v2, never replacing it); ADR-0005 A17 (native §9.1 class-4 leaders on the annotated a2 hosts, the D4-context partition beside the graded denominator, the N_min power clause with one census extension)

scope.gated_rule: ADR-0005 A17 Pin 2 — D4-context windows minted and scored, reported beside the graded denominator; every positive and every non-D4-context window is graded
scope.geometry: 1024-nt scan windows (ADR-0005 D3 / PRD §6 pinned geometry)

overlap_with_training_folds.method: canonical N-free 32-mers on either strand of the WHOLE native window (no insert to exclude) against the arm's own Stage-1 training-fold context_seq (host_screen.canonical_kmers / sorted_unique_kmers / kmer_hits)

host_pool.selection: ADR-0005 A17 — genuine §9.1 class-4 leaders: native 1,024-nt CDS- and tRNA-upstream windows on their feature's own strand (δ ~ U{0..256}, seed 42) on the 339 NCBI-annotated admissible a2 hosts, a 100,000-window seed-42 uniform draw (plus, on the one pre-registered extension, every remaining eligible window), screened by A15 Pins 1–2 unchanged; D4-context windows minted beside the graded denominator; no leader decoy, no §9.1 decoy pool; the selection reads no score

scope.negative_construction: ADR-0005 A17 Pins 1–2: native 1,024-nt windows from reports/p3/hardneg_pool.json's graded and beside lists, the bytes the pool screened (sha256 asserted per item)
scope.positive_population: benchmark_v2.json's graded positives (gate4_eval), contigs byte-identical (ADR-0005 A17 Pin 3)
scope.seen_by_rule: seen_by[arm] on a native window is the MEASURED fold overlap (any shared canonical 32-mer with the arm's training-fold context_seq), never a by-construction claim

beside_gate.rule: ADR-0005 A17 Pin 2 — a surviving window is D4-context if any CDS on the same seqid, either strand, overlapping [start - 500, end + 500) names a D4 class; such windows are minted, scored and reported beside the graded denominator, never inside it

blocks.rule: ADR-0005 A17 Pin 3 — positive cluster and negative assembly are the blocks

disclosures: Reported BESIDE v2 (reports/two_stage_precision_v2.json), never replacing it (ADR-0005 A16 Pin 5): the P3 exit record keeps 'A13 Pin 1: FAIL, underpowered, on v2' whatever this report shows.

The gated arm is the GATE-4 eval twin, not the shipped scanner; the twin saw 0 of the 1201 positives, which are v2's graded positive windows, byte-identical. The production arm's numbers are REPORTED, NOT GATED: its Stage-1 is in-sample on every positive.

ADR-0005 A17 Pin 5 (a) — CM circularity, as A15 Pin 7(a): a graded negative MEANS below 10.0 bits on RF00230/TBDB001 and free of the GGTGGNACCGCG motif on either strand (A15 Pin 2, unchanged), so a CM contestant is favoured by construction, and a learned model that finds a real but CM-invisible T-box in a graded window is scored as a false positive. This benchmark grades Stage-1-vs-two-stage integration; it is never evidence about novel-element recall, FDR or held-out-clade generalization.

ADR-0005 A17 Pin 5 (b) — prior scores exist on this substrate: production Stage-1 at τ = 0.9 scanned every admissible a2 host in round 0 and the shipped Stage-2 scored all 941 round-0 candidates. The selection rule reads neither. 3 of 750875 graded negatives overlap a round-0 candidate locus (2 distinct candidates); 1 of them draw a twin Stage-1 candidate. Their A12 Pin 4(e) orthogonal-criterion status: undetermined 3, no_orthogonal_pass 0, orthogonal_pass 0 (relaxed_architecture has no committed per-candidate source, so a window whose candidates pass neither other criterion is undetermined, not failed). Nothing is dropped on it, and the twin never scanned these genomes.

ADR-0005 A17 Pin 5 (c) — label-noise direction: a graded negative that is a real CM-invisible T-box penalises whichever system ranks it higher, so if Stage-2 detects such loci better than Stage-1 the bias runs AGAINST two-stage (conservative for the two-stage claim). The D4 partition moves 70416 windows beside the gate and reduces this risk without removing it; the extension's P-conditioned acceptance of the draw is a second-order tilt, which the census bounds.

ADR-0005 A17 Pin 5 (d) — a different benchmark from v2: the negatives are native windows on off-catalogue genomes in training orders, the positives catalogue records. Graded composition: cds_upstream 740587, trna_upstream 10288 over 339 assemblies; top clades Myxococcales 52100, Fusobacteriales 31085, Nostocales 23284, Thermococcales 23063, Vulcanimicrobiales 19764, Gemmatimonadales 18295, … (+111 more); D4 share 0.08573818536913226; the pool's per-rule refusals are draw: assembly_gap 777, fold 308, content 290 (refusal share 0.01375); census: assembly_gap 5403, fold 2123, content 2004 (refusal share 0.013015640620817377). The fold screen shifts the draw toward genomes distant from training, as A15 Pin 7(e) did.

ADR-0005 A17 Pin 5 (e) — the union mask is fail-open on a2 (A8) and no substrate pre-scan exists: the content screen is the only T-box screen, and its refusal count lower-bounds T-box content in the draw; a passing screen is NOT a claim the windows are clean.

ADR-0005 A17 Pin 5 (f) — A15 Pin 7(b)'s flank familiarity and Pin 7(d)'s six leader records in Stage-2 training carry over unchanged; measured here: the graded arm's familiarity baseline reaches AUPRC 0.997527 against Stage-1-only 0.997524 (+0.000 pp), so the gate is confounded by construction; a fix needs a twin retrain.

fewer than 20 graded negatives reached Stage-2; the hard-negative benchmark lacks power to test Stage-2: P = 6 of 750875 graded negatives reach a Stage-2 payload on the gated arm (N_min = 20); census extension triggered True (P on the draw 0). The A13 verdict is computed exactly as A13 does and recorded unchanged; README and the manuscript say so in A15 Pin 5's words.

Beside the gate (A17 Pin 2): 0 of 70416 D4-context windows draw a twin Stage-1 candidate and 0 a Stage-2 payload; with them ADDED to the denominator (not graded) the twin's AUPRC gain reads 0.00013331621833145846 pp.
The ADR-0005 D7 100:1 prevalence is reached by REWEIGHTING the graded negatives (λ = 100 · n_pos / n_graded_neg); the graded population's own composition is 625.208 negatives per positive.

Every positive is re-scored in this run (A15 Pin 6: Stage-2 logits depend on batch composition); on the gated arm 1198 of 1201 positives' two-stage scores differ from v2's (max |Δ| 0.009360606443569286).

ADR-0005 D3 freezes the Stage-1 threshold, the locus knobs and the Stage-2 operating point at the §13.1 phase gate (P5-01). Nothing here pins any of them; the knobs this run used are recorded under sources.rule_knobs.

familiarity_baseline.score: fraction of the item contig's canonical 32-mers present in the arm's own Stage-1 training DNA (fold context_seq, the admitted mined windows, the embedded decoy inserts) — ADR-0005 A15 Pin 7(b)

gate.definition: PRD §18.1 P3 exit — two-stage beats Stage-1-only precision on the in-distribution benchmark, graded (ADR-0005 A13) on the THRESHOLD-FREE statistic: AUPRC at the D7 pinned decoy prevalence, PRD §12's primary imbalance-aware metric

reported_not_gated.why: ADR-0005 D3 freezes the Stage-1 threshold and the Stage-2 operating point at P5-01, two phases after this gate; the matched-recall read is therefore reported at the values this run used and gated on neither

gate.underpowered_statement: fewer than 20 graded negatives reached Stage-2; the hard-negative benchmark lacks power to test Stage-2

census.selection: ADR-0005 A17: native §9.1 class-4 leaders (CDS-upstream + tRNA-upstream 1,024-nt windows, δ ~ U{0..256}) on the 339 annotated admissible a2 hosts; seed-42 uniform draw; A15 Pin 1 + Pin 2 screens unchanged; D4-context windows beside the graded set

draw.selection: ADR-0005 A17: native §9.1 class-4 leaders (CDS-upstream + tRNA-upstream 1,024-nt windows, δ ~ U{0..256}) on the 339 annotated admissible a2 hosts; seed-42 uniform draw; A15 Pin 1 + Pin 2 screens unchanged; D4-context windows beside the graded set

power.rule: ADR-0005 A17 Pin 4 — P = graded negatives (D4-context excluded) with >= 1 Stage-2 payload on the twin arm at Stage-1 τ = 0.5, counted from the payloads alone; underpowered iff the final P < N_min = 20; one census extension when the draw's P < N_min, decided on P alone
power.sentence: fewer than 20 graded negatives reached Stage-2; the hard-negative benchmark lacks power to test Stage-2

problems: the gate's verdict changes across the Stage-1 threshold sweep; ADR-0005 D3 leaves that value unpinned until P5-01, so the gate would rest on it

reported_not_gated.beside_gate: beside_gate (A17 Pin 2: D4-context negatives, never in the denominator)
reported_not_gated.rule: ADR-0005 A17 Pin 3 — reported, not graded: the production arm (arms.production); A13 Pin 2's matched-recall grid (arms.*.recall_grid) and the τ 0.7 / 0.9 reads (stage1_threshold_sensitivity); A13 Pin 3's 10:1 -> 10^4:1 sweep (arms.*.prevalence); the A15 Pin 7(b) familiarity baseline when supplied; and the block-bootstrap CIs (positive cluster + negative assembly). Per A13 Pin 4 no CI bar applies

round0_crosstab.rule: ADR-0005 A17 Pin 5(b) — a graded window overlaps a round-0 candidate when both lie on the same assembly and seqid and [start, end) intersects the candidate's 0-based half-open locus; strand-agnostic (the round-0 manifest records no strand); nothing is dropped on it
